prompt: Which of the following are INDIRECT (behavioural) costs of management controls?

options.text: Salaries of the internal audit staff

explanation: Displacement, gamesmanship, operating delays and negative attitudes are indirect costs. Audit staff salaries are a direct (out-of-pocket) cost.

prompt: Tight results control is more likely to be achieved when performance targets …

options.text: are congruent with the true organizational objectives
are vague so that managers have discretion

explanation: Tight results control needs congruent, complete, specific, communicated targets, precise and timely measurement, and a strong link to rewards. Vague targets lead to loose control.

prompt: In Malmi & Brown's framework of 'MCS as a package', which control types are distinguished?
explanation: Malmi & Brown (2008) distinguish five groups: planning, cybernetic, reward & compensation, administrative and cultural controls, which operate together as a package.
